docs.summary: A humanoid look at: turns the spine, neck, head and eyes toward a model space target by yaw and pitch, so the head never rolls.

docs.summary: Aims the head at `target` (model space), blended from the input pose by `weight`. `clampWeight` limits the yaw and pitch away from the body forward, from 180 degrees at 0 down to 30 degrees at 1.
